text.vehicle.tug.name: Jomon's steam tug
text.vehicle.horse_cart.name: Hearthford horse cart
text.vehicle.steam_crawler.name: Rillscar steam crawler
text.vehicle.rootwalker.name: Greenwold rootwalker
text.vehicle.aether_glider.name: Greywash aether glider
text.vehicle.board.tug.position: Board the tug from Jomon's gangplank.
text.vehicle.board.tug.unavailable: The tug cannot cast off during a voyage crisis or without an able courier.
text.vehicle.board.tug.route: This route stop has no charted regional shore for the tug.
text.vehicle.board.tug.mooring: The tug is not at Jomon's mooring.
text.vehicle.board.tug.success: You board the steam tug; Jomon lies at J and the regional shore at L.
text.vehicle.board.region.none: No vehicle is here to board.
text.vehicle.board.region.success: You take the controls of the {vehicle}. Tab opens its interior.
text.vehicle.disembark.none: There is no safe place to disembark.
text.vehicle.disembark.ground: Steer onto firm, walkable ground before disembarking.
text.vehicle.disembark.success: You step down from the {vehicle}; it remains here.
text.vehicle.navigate.none: No vehicle is under your control.
text.vehicle.navigate.disabled: The vehicle is disabled. Open its interior with Tab to jury-rig it.
text.vehicle.navigate.landscape: The vehicle is not in this landscape.
text.vehicle.navigate.no_charge: The vehicle has no charge. Open its interior with Tab to service it.
text.vehicle.navigate.blocked: That heading is blocked by terrain, a shoal, or an actor.
text.vehicle.navigate.tug_manual: Sweep oars keep the tug moving, one tile per two actions.
text.vehicle.navigate.glider_manual: Manual wing trim keeps the glider moving, one tile per two actions.
text.vehicle.navigate.frame: The frame needs a jury-rig before it can move again.
text.vehicle.service.frame_stand: A counted repair at the stand restores four measures of frame soundness.
text.vehicle.service.frame_jury: A three-action jury-rig restores one measure of frame soundness.
text.vehicle.service.halt: The {resource} recovers by twelve after a three-action halt.
text.vehicle.service.mana_requirement: The glider needs two personal mana to recharge.
text.vehicle.service.mana: Two mana enter the glider crystal; twelve aether charge returns.
text.vehicle.service.charcoal: One carried charcoal lot feeds the boiler for forty-eight charge.
text.vehicle.service.credit: One trade credit buys a counted charcoal charge at the stand.
text.vehicle.service.requirement: Bring a charcoal lot, or refuel for one credit at a mooring or vehicle stand.
text.vehicle.interior.none.title: NO VEHICLE
text.vehicle.interior.none: No vehicle is under your control.
text.vehicle.interior.guidance: Tab opens this walkable deck from the landscape; E uses the fixture underfoot.
text.vehicle.interior.controls: H helm, R reserve, F frame, C cargo manifest, E hatch. Tab/Escape returns to steering.
text.vehicle.interior.tug_marks: J marks Jomon; L marks the regional shore.
text.vehicle.interior.tug_manual: With no coal, sweep oars remain usable at half pace.
text.vehicle.interior.draw.controls: Arrows/HJKL walk; E uses the fixture; Tab/Esc returns to steering.
text.vehicle.interior.cargo: The cargo rack is part of the cabin; carried lots remain in the courier's pack.
text.vehicle.interior.fixture: Walk to H, R, F, C or E before using a cabin fixture.
text.vehicle.gangplank.choice.ashore: Walk ashore into the current region
text.vehicle.gangplank.choice.tug: Board Jomon's steam tug and steer across open water
text.vehicle.gangplank.title: JOMON GANGPLANK
text.vehicle.gangplank.line.tug: 2. Board the tug. J is Jomon's mooring; L is the regional shore.
text.vehicle.gangplank.line.crossing: The water crossing uses fuel, shoal wear, and one action per helm order.
